title: Report Library
subtitle: Shift & Cash Summary Reports · Admin walkthrough

intro.title: Report Library
lines: Every report for your organization lives here, organized by type under Finance.
Today we'll focus on shift reporting —
how front desk staff and managers close out cash at the end of a shift.
intro.narration: Welcome to the Report Library, in the Rec admin. Every report for your organization lives here, organized by type under Finance. Today we'll focus on shift reporting — how front desk staff and managers close out cash at the end of a shift.

steps.title: Daily Cashout · End-of-Day Summary
lines: The end-of-day reconciliation summary by location.
Filtered here to today and one team member, it totals their
cash, check, and credit card payments for the day.
steps.narration: The Daily Cashout report is the end-of-day reconciliation summary by location. Filtered here to today and one team member, it totals their cash, check, and credit card payments — the numbers a staff member checks against the drawer at the end of a shift.

steps.title: Cash Out · Reports
lines: The Reports tab lists every individual shift report a staff member has created.
A blank Submitted column means it's only been saved;
a timestamp means a manager has already reviewed and submitted it.
steps.narration: Switching to the Reports tab lists every individual shift report a staff member has created. A blank Submitted column means it's only been saved; a timestamp means a manager has already reviewed and submitted it.

steps.title: Cash Summary Report · Saved, Not Submitted
lines: A staff member enters the drawer total and less float —
deposit and over/short amounts calculate automatically.
Notes explain any discrepancy. Save keeps it in draft; Submit is for the manager.
steps.narration: This report has been saved but not yet submitted. A staff member enters the drawer total and less float, and the deposit and over-or-short amounts calculate automatically. They can leave a note explaining any discrepancy — Save keeps it in draft, while Submit is for the manager, once they've reviewed it.

steps.title: Reports · Filtered to Submitted
lines: Once a manager submits a report, it lands here —
filtered to Status: Submitted — with its final deposit total and over/short.
Managers can archive submitted reports from this list once they're no longer needed.
steps.narration: Once a manager submits a report, it lands here — the Reports tab filtered to Status: Submitted — with its final deposit total and over or short amount. Managers can archive submitted reports from this list once they're no longer needed.
